jobs.tierReason: review of a spend-cap path change: a retry that doubles max_tokens on the Anthropic lane
jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/followups.diff. Rules that must hold: (1) the new retry after a max_tokens cut-off on the Anthropic lane can never spend past the job cap, the per-day cap or the total cap (the worst case of the doubled request and the first call's cost are both counted before the second request is sent, batch jobs never retry, and a second truncation fails without a third request); (2) both calls are written to the spend ledger exactly once with the real usage (no double count, no missed call, also when the retry fails or the process is killed between the calls); (3) the returned costUsd and ledger agree; (4) normalizing a path returned both whole and as edits cannot let a worker write an undeclared output or skip the output-count check, and cannot hide a real error; (5) default concurrency 64 and max_tokens 4096 keep the stated rate-limit math, and the adaptive limit still works; (6) cacheContext on ticket jobs only lists files that are in context and cannot break manifest validation or leak private files into the cached block. Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
